descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lily Pad' Rare Dwarf Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 Excellent for Bonsai We are really happy to offer this exciting new variegated form of ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’. Acer palmatum ‘Lily Pad’ was a sport found on ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ and retains that nice dense habit that makes it so popular. Tight dense foliage makes for a perfect platform for this swirling variegation. We have found ‘Lily Pad’ to be extremely stable in its variegation. ‘Lily Pad’ was found at Don Schmidt Nursery and named for its low flat shape. The overall habit is rounded, like a lily pad. We estimate ‘Lily Pad’ to reach around 3 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 10 years making this an awesome dwarf selection. When I first got this tree, I was really blown away by how elongated and swirling the foliage is. The leaf shape gives ‘Lily Pad’ a very unique, regal and elegant quality to it. It’s a mikawa with a ruffle and stable variegation! It makes my heart skip a beat! I think you will really enjoy this new dwarf Japanese maple in your garden. If you are an experienced collector who enjoys the "Mikawa Family Collection" or a novice just getting into gardening this new tree is going to be a must! Whether it’s in the ground or a pot this one is going to be a show stopper in your collection!

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lily Pad' 稀有矮生日本枫，适生区 5-9，极适合盆景。 我们非常高兴推出这一令人兴奋的 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 新斑叶变异。 Acer palmatum ‘Lily Pad’ 是从 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 上发现的芽变，保留了其广受欢迎的致密株型。 紧密浓密的叶层为其旋涡状斑锦提供了完美展示。 我们观察到 ‘Lily Pad’ 的斑叶性状非常稳定。 ‘Lily Pad’ 发现于 Don Schmidt Nursery，因其低矮扁平的树形而得名，整体株形圆整，如睡莲叶一般。 我们估计 ‘Lily Pad’ 在 10 年内可长至约 3 英尺高、4 英尺宽，是极佳的矮生品种。 我第一次见到这棵树时，就被它叶片修长且带旋动感的形态深深吸引。 独特的叶形赋予 ‘Lily Pad’ 非常独到、华贵而优雅的气质。 它兼具 mikawa 系的褶皱感与稳定斑叶，令人怦然心动！ 相信无论在庭园中种植，还是作为收藏，你都会非常喜欢这款新的矮生日本枫。 无论你是钟爱 “Mikawa Family Collection” 的资深藏家，还是刚开始接触园艺的新手，这个新品种都会是不容错过之选。 无论地栽还是盆栽，它都会成为藏品中的焦点。
